resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Arabic source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, route checks, and generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Arabic pass identified 25 remaining unit-formatting, terminology, and technical-clarity defects across Ohm's law, Joule heating, Kirchhoff laws, TCR, trigonometry, thermal concepts, SI conversions, and wire gauges; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Arabic human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The kilo-ohm conversion used inconsistent localized symbols and grouping.
evidence: The previous bullet used localized kΩ and an ungrouped 1000.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the unambiguous engineering form ‘1 kΩ = 1,000 Ω’.

findings.summary: The mega-ohm conversion localized the unit inconsistently.
evidence: The previous bullet used Arabic unit text and inconsistent digit grouping.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘1 MΩ = 1,000,000 Ω’.

findings.summary: The milliampere conversion mixed Arabic abbreviations with the SI unit expression.
evidence: The previous bullet used Arabic text for mA and A.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘1 mA = 0.001 A’.

findings.summary: The watt conversion incorrectly described mW as megawatts.
evidence: The previous bullet rendered 1 W = 1000 mW with wording meaning megawatts.
findings.resolution: Corrected it to the unambiguous relation ‘1 W = 1,000 mW’.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating setup used an ambiguous Arabic ampere abbreviation and awkward verb.
evidence: The previous setup said ‘ملف 0.8 Ω يحمل 3 أ’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as ‘يمر تيار قدره 3 A في ملف مقاومته 0.8 Ω’.

findings.summary: The series-cell explanation was awkward and did not clearly distinguish voltage from ampere-hour capacity.
evidence: The previous bullet used ‘بقدر خلية واحدة متساوية’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to state that series cells add voltage while capacity remains approximately that of one cell.

findings.summary: The parallel-cell explanation used an awkward verb for combining available capacity and current.
evidence: The previous bullet said the quantities ‘تضيف’ without a clear technical construction.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to state that parallel cells keep the same voltage while capacity and available current approximately combine.

findings.summary: The constant-voltage TCR explanation used an imprecise construction for a resistor with positive TCR.
evidence: The previous paragraph used ‘بالنسبة لمقاومة TCR موجبة’ and a literal current clause.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with clear positive-TCR, constant-voltage, and constant-current relationships.

findings.summary: The manufacturer-range limitation paragraph used repetitive and less precise technical phrasing.
evidence: The previous paragraph listed effects without clearly separating the specified range from real-world deviations.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to distinguish the manufacturer's range from thermal gradients, material changes, contacts, stress, and self-heating.

findings.summary: The angular-frequency bullet used a passive construction that was less direct.
evidence: The previous bullet began ‘يتم قياس التردد الزاوي’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the direct technical wording ‘يقاس التردد الزاوي ω بالراديان لكل ثانية’.

findings.summary: The sign-and-quadrant instruction used المرحلة for phase and an incomplete imperative.
evidence: The previous bullet ended ‘عندما يكون الاتجاه أو المرحلة مهمًا’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘حافظ على إشارة العدد والربع عندما يكون الاتجاه أو الطور مهمًا’.

findings.summary: The temperature-difference formula localized the degree unit in prose rather than preserving the standard symbol.
evidence: The previous formula ended with ‘50 درجة مئوية’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘ΔT = 70 - 20 = 50 °C’.

findings.summary: The limitation paragraph called specific heat simply heat and used an imprecise result phrase.
evidence: The previous paragraph used ‘الحرارة النوعية ثابتة’ and repeated النتيجة الحقيقية/المثالية.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it using ‘السعة الحرارية النوعية’ and a clearer distinction between actual and ideal results.

findings.summary: The area-conversion instruction was a noun fragment rather than a direct instruction.
evidence: The previous bullet began ‘حول المساحة’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the complete imperative ‘حوّل المساحة إلى m² قبل استخدام W/m²’.

findings.summary: The SI table header used a corrupted Arabic rendering of SI unit.
evidence: The previous header was ‘وحدة سي’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘وحدة SI’.

findings.summary: The SI length row localized the standard symbol m into Arabic text.
evidence: The previous row used ‘م’ for the SI symbol.
findings.resolution: Changed the row to ‘الطول / متر / m’.

findings.summary: The SI temperature row used an Arabic letter instead of the standard kelvin symbol K.
evidence: The previous row ended with ‘ك’.
findings.resolution: Changed the row to ‘درجة الحرارة / كلفن / K’.

findings.summary: The SI current row used an Arabic letter instead of the standard ampere symbol A.
evidence: The previous row ended with ‘أ’.
findings.resolution: Changed the row to ‘التيار الكهربائي / أمبير / A’.

findings.summary: The watt bullet labeled power as energy.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘الطاقة: واط’.
findings.resolution: Corrected the physical quantity to ‘القدرة: واط (W)’.

findings.summary: The newton bullet used a localized symbol rather than the standard N.
evidence: The previous bullet ended with ‘ن’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘القوة: نيوتن (N)’.

findings.summary: The pascal bullet used a localized symbol rather than the standard Pa.
evidence: The previous bullet used Arabic text for the pascal symbol.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘الضغط: باسكال (Pa)’.

findings.summary: The foot conversion formula retained the English word foot.
evidence: The previous formula began ‘1 foot = ...’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘1 قدم = 12 بوصة = 0.3048 m’.

findings.summary: The yard conversion formula retained English unit names and feet.
evidence: The previous formula began ‘1 yard = 3 feet’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘1 ياردة = 3 أقدام = 0.9144 m’.

findings.summary: The pound-force conversion was translated with the same ambiguous label as pound mass.
evidence: The previous bullet used ‘1 رطل ≈ 4.44822 ن’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the unambiguous relation ‘1 lbf ≈ 4.44822 N’.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge comparison table corrupted the AWG header into unrelated Arabic wording.
evidence: The previous header was ‘الفريق العامل المخصص’.
findings.resolution: Restored the technical system name ‘AWG’.
